research_rationale: This partial candidate preserves provisional NO and identifies the actual earlier-cessation question instead of using the 1982 cleanup date. The entire official extract of EO12095 identifies the Wien Air Alaska/Air Line Pilots Association dispute and contains two numbered provisions: a three-member investigative board with a member-disqualification rule, and a report within30days. Three exact spans preserve these distinct commands. The complete actor EO12379 section5 revokes EO12095; its present-tense command, no deferred effective provision elsewhere, and dated heading/tail support August17,1982 as a formal revocation event only. Original and actor PDF hashes match GPO fixity rows, and neither extract has a material identity, operative-boundary, or completeness ambiguity; no page-image verification is claimed. Actual investigative/report completion and the statutes expressly invoked are required before finding first end or closing residual effects. No termination date is computed from the deadline. The OFR and eCFR machine scopes were judged suitable as bounded later-reference searches after rejecting the corrupted cross-actor chains; they do not establish the historical report event.
unresolved_material_gaps: Actual completion of this Wien Air Alaska board investigation and submission of its findings to the President has not been established. Section1-102 sets a 30-day reporting deadline, not a termination date or proof of a submitted report; first_end and whole_order_end remain null.

The order expressly invokes section44 of the Airline Deregulation Act of1978 (Public Law95-504) and section10 of the Railway Labor Act. The controlling statutory text governing this board and any post-report legal effects was not held in the inspected evidence. Its effect on first cessation and residuals therefore remains unclosed.
